description: M10: profile likelihood in the semi-major axis under Student-t errors (ν = 4, S3's scales), pre-registered in docs/notes/M10.md (2026-11-10). Diagnostic only; no published number changes. Q is on the χ² scale; Δ ln L = −ΔQ/2.

status_codes.2: ftol satisfied: the relative change of the cost in the last step is below 1e-10
status_codes.3: xtol satisfied: the relative step is below 1e-10
